description.value: Thai Affair Rolled Gelato is a seasonal, beach-side stand in White Rock serving Thai-style rolled gelato — a technique where liquid cream is poured onto a frozen plate and rolled into cylinders — in flavours like Tiramisu, Kinder Bueno, and Salted Caramel. Founded in 2017 near White Rock beach, the concept grew out of the founder's travels in Southeast Asia and has since expanded to Richmond Night Market and several Vancouver park locations. Every flavour on the menu is available in a fully vegan version.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Thai Affair Rolled Gelato is a real, active seasonal rolled gelato business. The OSM address (15505, unit 103) does not match the White Rock location listed on the website (14970 Marine Drive, behind the museum), which is flagged as a concern. The website explicitly advertises vegan versions of all flavours; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. The phone number 604-786-0737 appears on the website's contact page but is absent from OSM.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM lists 15505 unit 103 (V4B 1C9, suggesting a strip-mall unit), but the website's White Rock location is 14970 Marine Drive (described as 'behind museum'). The website address has been used; the OSM address may be stale or incorrect.
Phone number (604-786-0737) and email (info@thaiaffairgelato.com) are present on the website but absent from OSM tags.
Seasonal operation: website indicates the business operates only part of the year; may be closed at time of visit.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating business with an active website and multiple confirmed locations. A beachside gelato stand is a natural stop for touring cyclists on the White Rock waterfront.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website lists three active locations (White Rock Marine Drive, Creekside Park/False Creek Seawall at 1455 Quebec St Vancouver, and Richmond Night Market at 8351 River Road). This OSM record corresponds to the White Rock location.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Vegan gelato is now available in all flavours' and has a dedicated vegan menu page listing coconut whipped cream and vegan caramel/chocolate sauce substitutions for every flavour
